Name: Kemuel, Father of Hashabiah
Summary: Father of Hashabiah the ruler of the Levites.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:17: Father of Hashabiah the ruler of the Levites.
LifeLesson: The mention of Kemuel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
